author: Johannes Schickling
text: RCA update (2026-02-22): Root cause points to async leader-push window in ClientSessionSyncProcessor.push. Local stress harness without injection stayed green (300/300), but controlled fault injection delaying background leader push reproduced the exact empty-draft-after-reload symptom deterministically (iteration 1). Counter-test waiting longer than injected delay removed failures. Fast-path and awaitSharedWorkerTermination toggles did not mitigate injected-delay failures. See livestore tmp/rca-1062/investigation.md and H005 findings for details.

author: Johannes Schickling
text:
## Investigation Results (2026-02-07)

### Measurements

| Scenario | Time | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| curl (baseline) | ~6ms | Direct HTTP, no overhead |
| otel health direct (bypass direnv) | ~360ms | Bun + TS module loading |
| Bun startup alone | ~8ms | Bun is fast; TS module load is ~350ms |
| direnv exec . true (warm cache) | ~875ms | direnv env setup + cached task checks |
| direnv exec . otel health (warm) | ~1.2s | direnv (~875ms) + otel (~360ms) |
| direnv exec . true (cold, no task cache) | ~13-21s | Full task execution (ts:build dominates) |

### Where time goes (cold start breakdown from traces)

Cold start runs devenv:enterShell which depends on setup:opt:* tasks:
- setup:opt:ts:build: ~13s (the dominator — runs tsc --build)
- pnpm:install:* chain: ~6s total (sequential, ~400-600ms each x ~15 packages)
- setup:opt:genie:run: ~1.5s
- setup:opt:megarepo:sync: ~0.5s

### OTEL observability gap

The cold-start overhead is invisible to dt traces. direnv runs devenv-tasks first (cold path), warming all caches. By the time dt runs, everything is cached (~680ms). The cold-start tasks emit orphan spans (no TRACEPARENT) which DO show up in Tempo with task.cached=false.

### Key insight: bimodal distribution

The overhead is NOT consistent:
- Warm (typical): ~1.2s — acceptable for interactive use, 200x slower than curl
- Cold (after cache clear/rebuild): ~13-21s — creates the perception of slowness

Cold starts happen after: direnv reload, clearing .direnv/task-cache, or switching branches.

author: Johannes Schickling
text:
## Root Cause Analysis (updated 2026-02-08)

### Why `direnv exec .` is needed
It's NOT actually needed. It's an artifact of running from a non-direnv shell (e.g. this bash tool, CI, etc.). In an interactive terminal where direnv has already loaded the env, you just run `otel health` directly — which takes ~360ms.

The `direnv exec` path is only needed when:
- Running from a tool/shell that hasn't loaded the direnv env
- CI environments
- Scripts that need to be self-contained

### Where the ~900ms warm overhead actually goes

The devenv `print-dev-env` output (cached in `.devenv/shell-*.sh`) contains a hardcoded call to:
```
devenv-tasks run devenv:enterShell --mode all
```

This runs on EVERY `direnv exec` call, even when all tasks are cached. It:
1. Starts the devenv-tasks binary (~50ms)
2. Loads and parses the task graph from tasks.json
3. Runs ~30 task status checks sequentially (each ~1ms but fork/exec adds up)
4. The entire enterShell tree executes: setup:gate, setup:opt:*, pnpm:install:*, megarepo:sync, beads:daemon:ensure, devenv:files, git-hooks, etc.

### Corrected latency breakdown

| Component | Time | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| direnv env cache lookup | ~20ms | Checks if watched files changed |
| Shell script `eval` (env vars) | ~30ms | Sources the cached shell-*.sh |
| `devenv-tasks run devenv:enterShell` | ~800ms | The dominator — runs on every exec |
| Actual command (e.g. `otel health`) | ~360ms | Bun + TS module load + HTTP calls |

### Implication
The ~900ms overhead is inherent to how devenv hooks into the shell. It's not a bug — it's ensuring the dev environment is always consistent. But for CLI tools like `otel` that just need env vars, it's unnecessary work.

author: Johannes Schickling
text:
CI failing on both Linux and macOS with identical 9 test timeouts (5000ms default):

- otel-cli.unit.test.ts: 6 failures — all makeOtelCliLayer tests (creates layer, includes parent span, handles invalid traceparent, custom export interval, trailing slash, combines with other layers)
- playwright/otel.unit.test.ts: 3 failures — currentParentSpanContextJson tests that create real OTEL spans, plus the round-trip integration test

Root cause: tests that create actual OTEL layers/spans exceed the 5000ms default vitest timeout in CI. These tests likely need either increased timeouts or mocked OTEL infrastructure to avoid real span export overhead.

CI run: https://github.com/overengineeringstudio/effect-utils/actions/runs/21800054068

author: Johannes Schickling
text:
Problem: CLAUDE.md only references beads in the "Landing the Plane" section (end of session). No instructions exist for agents to check beads at session start to discover context about the current branch/PR. This causes agents to miss existing epics and child issues directly relevant to their work.

Fix: Add a "Session Start" section to CLAUDE.md instructing agents to: (1) check for related beads epics, (2) review epic children to understand scope/progress, (3) use that context to orient before starting work.
